title: Dispatch params advertise project_dir but the design contract names cwd canonical
wanted_capability: Flip the schema-advertised dispatch-param name to cwd (contract-bottom name per design/bro-harness/tool-arg-defaulting.md) and migrate tool docs/prompts/atom templates in the same pass so model priors and docs agree. Today the schema advertises project_dir and accepts cwd as an alias (830c2c0) — the inverse of the contract.
notes: Item 3 of thread-55d51135. Mechanical but must be done as one pass (schema + docs + prompts + atom templates) to avoid split priors.
resolution_note: Fixed in 1cab57b (worktree-scope-cluster): bro_exec/bro_resume/bro_agent_dispatch/bro_broadcast schemas advertise cwd; project_dir kept as deprecated serde alias (no caller/atom/workflow breakage). Tool docs, prompts, examples, design docs migrated same-pass. Load-bearing finding: the ToolArgDefaults table applies BEFORE daemon-side alias normalization, so the managed-worktree pin now emits both pin:*.cwd and pin:*.project_dir; glob-rule validation made param-existence-scoped so *-glob pins stay quiet on profiles without dispatch tools. Closes thread-55d51135 item 3 (design doc §4 conformity pass).
